product_summary: Abhi Healthcare (Ankleshwar GIDC, Bharuch, Gujarat; founded 2004 by Kishor Kachhadia; sister concern of Alex Group) is an importer/exporter and global sourcing house, NOT a manufacturer. Its own site lists the product lines: APIs; Veterinary APIs; Solvents & Chemicals; Excipients; Cosmetic Ingredients; Surfactants; Pigments; Dyes; Pellets & Granules; Intermediates; Food & Nutraceutical Ingredients. Target industries: pharma, food, nutraceutical, cosmetic, specialty chemicals, plus textile, leather, polymer, paint, ink, plastics. Declared HS 300490 (medicaments, retail packs) covers only the finished-formulation tail of the range; the bulk of the catalogue is upstream chemistry (solvents, intermediates, dyes, pigments, surfactants) and non-pharma ingredients, which sit in chapters 28-34 and 21/33, not 30.
comment: HS 300490 = partial. It is plausible for the API/formulation and pellets & granules lines, but the declaration omits the majority of the actual catalogue: solvents & basic/fine/specialty chemicals (ch. 29/38), intermediates (ch. 29), dyes (3204) and pigments (3206), surfactants (3402), excipients (3504/3507/3824), cosmetic ingredients (3304) and food/nutraceutical ingredients (2106). Industry claimed as 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a misclassification: the company is a pharma/food/cosmetic/specialty-chemical sourcing trader, with no oil & gas line on its site. Strong trader signs: self-described 'Importer, Exporter & Global Sourcing Company', 'End to End Sourcing Solutions from India to the World', '200+ manufacturers' as partners, 'One Stop Shop', free samples, and a portfolio spanning 11 unrelated product families - a distributor profile, not a plant. No manufacturing facility or plant capacity is claimed anywhere on the site. Per Rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company is retained, code to be corrected to the actual multi-chapter range above. All product lines are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - no customs line, invoice or B-L was checked in this pass (out of scope for this role), so nothing here is corroborated by a shipment record. Note: abhihealthcare.in is an unrelated telemedicine platform, not this company - do not conflate. Sources: https://abhihealthcare.com/ (homepage nav + body copy, accessed this pass).
